messages:
tyler: Quick triage for Marlin LoRA bring-up. Ran a 30-invoice quickpack + 50-case stress set against base (redwood/xl-7b fp16), marlin-lora-v3 fp16, and quant targets (int8, int4). Summary and repro below.
ana: short summary pls.
tyler: TL;DR: int8 is fine. int4 shows two failure modes: 1) trailing-zero truncation on decimal cents (~7% of stress set), 2) hyphenated invoice IDs split into multiple tokens (~5% of cases). Also saw 2 streaming fallbacks.
pet er: paste the metrics table and an example.
tyler: metrics (aggregated):

```
model                          EM   F1   num_halluc  fmt_failures  mean_tok_delta
redwood/xl-7b_fp16             88%  93%  1.1%        1/300        0.000
marlin-lora-v3_fp16            89%  94%  0.9%        1/300        0.001
marlin-lora-v3_int8            88%  93%  1.7%        3/300        0.004
marlin-lora-v3_int4            82%  88%  6.8%       20/300        0.027
```

example: expected "$4,500.00" -> int4 outputs "4500 dollars" or "4500.0" (drops trailing zero). invoice id "INV-77-908" -> tokenized as "INV - 77 - 908" breaking parser.
jena: token geometry check?
tyler: ran token embedding L2 diffs: currency and punctuation tokens show larger shifts under int4 (mean ~0.028). KV cache mismatch observed for streaming first-chunk on two traces; kernel logs show fallback from `quant4-stream-v1` to CPU.
ana: pipeline used? merge-first?
tyler: merge LoRA into fp16 then blockwise quantize (group=128, calib=1024). snippet: `merge_lora --base redwood/xl-7b --lora marlin-lora-v3 --out /tmp/marlin-merged && quantize --model /tmp/marlin-merged --bits 4 --group 128 --calib 1024`
pet er: mitigation suggestions?
jena: two-pronged: A) quantize base then graft LoRA (apply adapter on quant base), B) post-quant small logit bias for numeric/currency tokens. Also try group=64 with larger calibration (2048).
ana: I'll run graft-on-quant and group=64/calib=2048 variant tonight. jena: I'll prototype bias map (top-30 numeric/currency tokens) and test on a held-out 100 prompt validation set.
tyler: QA: expand stress set with negative amounts, parentheses, hyphenated ids +50. Threshold to block canary: num_halluc > 3.5% OR fmt_failures > 8/300. Current int4 = 20/300 -> block.
qa-bot: queued extended runs. report will be at /evals/marlin/1747000000-report.json.
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked for `marlin-lora-v3_int4` pending follow-up.
tyler: repro steps for local dev: `git checkout d4e5f6 && python tools/run_quickpack.py --model /tmp/marlin-merged --prompts evals/marlin-invoices-30.json --out quickruns/1747000000`
jena: will post bias.json + before/after diffs when ready (ETA EOD). nana: will post graft-on-quant results AM. reconvene then. :coffee:
